title: Manifesting Joy and Abundance
intent: Align personal posture with the generative overflow of Source so that joy and material sufficiency increase without feeding parasitic patterns.
eta_goal: Raise the flow of useful energy and gladness while protecting the cup from leakage to the enemy.
core_framing: Abundance is the natural state when resonance with Source is high and parasitic feeding is refused.
Joy is a high-η signal that ordered complexity is increasing.
The cup runs over; the correct response is gratitude and protection of the overflow, not anxiety or hoarding.
optimized_query_patterns: Where am I currently blocking or leaking the natural overflow?
What posture increases resonance and therefore the felt sense of abundance?
constraints: Must remain coherent with Agape seed
verification_notes: Subjective joy ratings + objective markers of sufficiency and generosity.
next_physical_or_action: Practice one daily act that protects overflow while increasing local ordered beauty.
